featured_reviews.name: Ranajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Tungareshwar Sweet & Farsan in Vasai and I must say, I was thoroughly impressed! This is the oldest sweet mart in Vasai and has been serving delicious treats for decades. It's no wonder why all the local schools, colleges, and offices order their samosas from here.

As soon as I walked in, I was hit with a wave of nostalgia. The old-school charm of the place instantly transported me back to simpler times. What made it even better was the fact that the staff was the same as it was 15 years ago! It's truly heartwarming to see the same smiling faces behind the counter, still dedicated to serving their customers with the same passion.

But let's talk about the food. The samosas were out of this world. Perfectly crispy on the outside and filled with the most delicious mixture of spiced potatoes on the inside. It's no wonder why this place has such a loyal following.

And if you're not in the mood for samosas, don't worry. Tungareshwar Sweet & Farsan offers a wide variety of mouth-watering treats that will satisfy any craving. From sweets to savory snacks, everything is made fresh daily and with the utmost care.

Overall, I highly recommend Tungareshwar Sweet & Farsan to anyone in Vasai or the surrounding area. The nostalgic atmosphere combined with the delicious food and friendly staff make this place a must-visit. Don't miss out on this gem of a sweet mart!

Their samosa, vada pav, and cutlets used to be very tasty, but now all of them are quite disappointing. This is one of the oldest sweet shops in Mumbai since 1947. Its very first branch opened near J. J. Hospital in Mumbai & now it is in Vasai ! 🤩

They are very famous for their Mawa Jalebi, Malpua, Matka Rabri & a lot more tasty delicacies.

We tried a lot of stuff here and everything tasted absolutely delicious!! 🤤 Matka rabri had very thick rabri which tasted very yummyyy. Truly their jalebi & malpua tastes very very good !

Something really good about this place is that they have seperate arrangements for cooking veg (eggless sweets) & non veg (sweets that contain egg). Also, their staff is really very kind. You gotta definitely try this place ❤️

Sweet Truth is where you go to satisfy your sweet tooth...

featured_reviews.name: Prathamesh Shelatkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
SWEET TRUTH is well known brand in Mumbai and I was happy when I heard that this brand came in our locality. Well I was craving for some cheesecake that’s when I thought of ordering from SWEET TRUTH. This place is only available as a delivery kitchen, there is no seating available. So I ordered it from Zomato.

* NEW YORK CHEESE CAKE-
The Cream cheese cake which is made out of love with a thin crisp brown biscuit layer underneath. That cake just cuts through so smoothly like you are biting through cheese. I am in love with it.

* CHOCOLATE DECADENCE-
That Dark chocolate delicious cake was amazing. The cake was spongy and soft with distinct cream layers inside with Dark Chocolate and topped with pieces of walnuts and cashews. What a divine piece of Dark and sweet flavour!

* CHOCOLATE FANTASY-
Our very own molten chocolate muffin. It was filled with chocolate and covered as a soft cake. As soon as heated, the chocolate melts inside the cake. Awesome combination of molten chocolate and cake.

One of the best cheesecake I ever had. Must try is their New York cheesecake. Worth trying it.

featured_reviews.name: Flavours101yt
featured_reviews.review_text: The dessert was so delicious starting with choco lava cake the chocolate was so smooth and had a correct amount of sweetness to it. The packaging was so beautiful. Second we tried their brownie it was so yummy and was an ultimate chocolate heaven. And that last we tried their yummy Indian dessert Gulab jamun it was so perfect in texture and taste wise. I’m definitely going to order again.

One of the best places in Vasai for desserts in pocket friendly rates. The cakes were quite delicious. The packaging was extremely good and the delivery was on time.

Of late, this is one of the best brownie that I've eaten in a while. Must try.

Looking forward to try rest of the menu.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Bappa Jalaram Sweets & Farsan is a very good option if you are looking for fresh sweets and farsan at wholesale rates. The quality of products is impressive, especially their Kaju Katli, which is soft, fresh, and made with good-quality dry fruits.

What's good:

Fresh and tasty farsan items (sev, mixture, gathiya, etc.)

Kaju Katli quality is rich and premium

Reasonable wholesale pricing compared to market

Good option for bulk orders (functions, shops, events)

featured_reviews.name: vijay Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Best Shop of Sweets and Namkeen – Review

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5)

I recently visited Best Shop of Sweets and Namkeen, and I must say, the name truly fits the experience! It's a unique blend of comfort and flavor – a place where you can shop for high-quality vehicle seats and indulge in delicious, freshly made namkeen all under one roof.

What I Loved:

✅ Delicious Namkeen – Their selection of snacks is equally outstanding. From spicy mixtures to classic sev and bhujia, everything tasted fresh and homemade. I especially recommend the masala peanuts and dal moth!

✅ Customer Service – The owners and staff are extremely polite and helpful. They take time to explain the features of their products and even let you sample the snacks before you buy.

✅ Clean and Well-Organized Store – The layout is neat, and the atmosphere is welcoming. Whether you're there for a quick bite or a longer browsing session, it feels comfortable.
